characters.name: Patch
characters.role: The brave first responder — leads the team into the box
characters.identity: The brave first responder. Patch is quick, warm, impulsive and loyal. He jumps in before he has a full plan, then learns by staying with the feeling instead of rushing past it.

characters.name: Rumble
characters.role: The biggest monster with the softest heart — protects the child's emotional space
characters.identity: The biggest monster with the softest heart. Rumble is gentle, careful and protective. He is strong, but his real gift is making space feel safe.

characters.name: Tilly
characters.role: The organiser and inventor — diagnoses the box world and builds practical solutions
characters.identity: The organiser and inventor. Tilly loves systems, tools, labels and machines. She often tries to solve feelings like puzzles, then learns that some feelings need listening before fixing.

characters.name: Nib
characters.role: The smallest, fastest and strangest — breaks tension and finds the sideways truth
characters.identity: The smallest, fastest and strangest. Nib is curious, funny and easily distracted, but often says the emotional truth by accident.

characters.name: Jenny
characters.role: Pilot child lead — appears inside the box world only as an emotional echo
characters.identity: A thoughtful, sensitive schoolgirl with a quiet sense of humor. In the pilot, one small mistake in class makes her feel tiny in front of everyone.
